COMMERCIAL   GENERAL LIABILITY COVERAGE FORM (SYNTHETIC, FOR DEMONSTRATION ONLY)

SECTION I - INSURING AGREEMENTS

101. Coverage A — Bodily Injury and Property Damage Liability
We will pay those sums that the Insured
becomes legally obligated to pay as damages because of “Bodily Injury” or
“Property Damage” to which this insurance applies.   We will have the right and duty to defend the insured against any “Suit” seeking those damages.

102. Coverage B — Medical Payments
We will pay medical expenses as described below for “Bodily Injury” caused by an accident on premises you own or rent, regardless of fault.

SECTION II - EXCLUSIONS

103. Exclusion — Expected or Intended Injury
This insurance does not apply to “Bodily Injury” or “Property Damage” expected or intended from the standpoint of the Insured.

104. Exclusion — Contractual Liability
This insurance does not apply to “Bodily Injury” or “Property Damage” for which the insured is obligated to pay damages by reason of the assumption of liability in a contract or agreement.

105. Exclusion — Pollution
This insurance does not apply to “Bodily Injury” or “Property Damage” arising out of the actual, alleged or threatened discharge, dispersal, seepage, migration, release or defect of pollutants.

SECTION III - SUPPLEMENTARY PAYMENTS

106. Supplementary Payments — General
With respect to any claim we investigate or settle, we will pay all costs we incur and premiums on appeal bonds.

107. Supplementary Payments — Bail Bonds
We will also pay the cost of bail bonds required because of accidents or traffic law violations arising out of the use of any vehicle to which this insurance applies, up to $250.

SECTION IV - LIMITS OF INSURANCE

108. Each Occurrence Limit
The Each Occurrence Limit is $1,000,000, subject to the General Aggregate Limit shown below.

109. General Aggregate Limit
The General Aggregate Limit is $2,000,000 and is the most we will pay for the sum of all damages under Coverage A regardless of the number of insureds, claims made or suits brought.

110. Fire Legal Liability Limit
The Fire Legal Liability Limit is $300,000 for damages because of “Property Damage” to premises rented to the named insured arising out of any one fire.

SECTION V - DEDUCTIBLE

111. Property Damage Deductible
A deductible of $1,000 per occurrence applies to each claim for “Property Damage” before we make any payment under this policy.

SECTION VI - DEFINITIONS

112. “Bodily Injury” means bodily injury, sickness or disease sustained by a person, including death resulting from any of these at any time.

113. “Property Damage” means physical injury to tangible property, including all resulting loss of use of that property.

114. “Occurrence” means an accident, including continuous or repeated exposure to substantially the same general harmful conditions.

115. “Insured” means the named insured shown in the declarations, any partner or executive officer while acting within the scope of duties, and any volunteer worker while acting at the direction of and within the scope of duties for the named insured.

SECTION VII - CONDITIONS

116. Other Insurance
If other valid and collectible insurance is available for a loss we cover, our obligations are limited as described in this condition.
